executive_summary_zh: 今天候选内容整体偏弱，主要是 GitHub Changelog 的产品更新，技术深度有限。
其中最有执行价值的是 Azure DevOps 到 GitHub Enterprise Cloud 的在线迁移 GA，它直接影响大型工程组织的源码托管迁移路径与停机窗口设计。
其余内容更多属于协作体验优化而非 AI 编码、评测、代理或开发者工具范式变化。
executive_summary_en: The candidate set is weak overall, dominated by GitHub changelog entries with limited technical depth.

The highest-actionability item is the GA of live migrations from Azure DevOps to GitHub Enterprise Cloud, which materially affects source-hosting migration strategy and cutover design for large engineering orgs.
The remaining items are mostly collaboration UX improvements rather than substantive advances in AI coding, evals, agents, or developer tooling architecture.

items.title: Enterprise Live Migrations from Azure DevOps generally available
items.summary_zh: GitHub 宣布 Azure DevOps Services 到 GitHub Enterprise Cloud（含数据驻留）的 Enterprise Live Migrations 正式 GA。其核心能力是持续同步仓库变更，让团队在迁移期间继续开发，并在可控时间点完成短切换；同时迁移 Git 历史、分支、标签、PR 及评论，并可保留 Azure Boards 与 Azure Pipelines 的连接。
items.summary_en: GitHub announced GA for Enterprise Live Migrations from Azure DevOps Services to GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency. The key capability is continuous sync during migration so teams can keep shipping until a controlled cutover window, while preserving Git history, branches, tags, pull requests, comments, and optionally wiring Azure Boards and Azure Pipelines to the migrated repos.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 对平台负责人而言，这不是单纯“迁移支持”，而是降低大规模源码平台切换的组织阻力：停机时间更短、切换可编排、审计与历史信息保留更完整。对正在推进 GitHub/Copilot 标准化的企业，这类在线迁移能力往往是 adoption 的关键前置条件。
items.why_it_matters_en: For platform leaders, this is more than migration support: it reduces organizational friction in large-scale source-hosting moves by shrinking downtime, enabling orchestrated cutovers, and preserving more audit/history context. For enterprises standardizing on GitHub and Copilot, live migration capability is often a prerequisite for adoption.
key_takeaways_zh: 支持持续同步与延后切换，意味着迁移可以从一次性“大爆炸”转向分阶段、低停机模式。
分支策略、PR 历史、评论与用户历史可迁移，有助于保留工程治理与协作上下文。
key_takeaways_en: Continuous sync plus delayed cutover shifts migrations from big-bang events to phased, low-downtime transitions.
Migration of branch policies, PR history, comments, and user context helps preserve engineering governance and collaboration history.

items.title: Improvements on the pull request overview in public preview
items.summary_zh: GitHub 对 PR Overview 公测页做了多项迭代，包括更清晰的 merge 状态与 next steps、可展开的 checks/approvals、已解决 review thread 自动折叠、force-push 前后提交对比链接，以及在评论提及 Copilot 时更明确显示将触发的动作与模型。
items.summary_en: GitHub shipped multiple refinements to the PR Overview public preview, including clearer merge status and next steps, expandable checks/approvals, auto-collapsing resolved threads, compare links for force-push events, and clearer disclosure of the action and model when invoking Copilot from comments.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 虽然不算重磅技术发布，但它反映了代码审查界面正在围绕‘人类评审 + AI 参与’重构：状态表达、上下文压缩和 agent 触发透明度都在变得更重要。对管理代码评审效率与可审计性的团队，这些细节会影响采用率。
items.why_it_matters_en: While not a major technical release, it signals that code review surfaces are being redesigned around human review plus AI participation: status clarity, context compression, and transparency around agent invocation are becoming first-class concerns. Those details affect adoption for teams optimizing review throughput and auditability.
key_takeaways_zh: PR 界面优化重点从单纯展示信息转向减少评审歧义、压缩噪音并提升操作可解释性。
Copilot 触发前更明确展示动作与模型，说明 AI 辅助代码审查正在加强可见性与可控性。
key_takeaways_en: The PR surface is evolving from raw information display toward reducing review ambiguity, suppressing noise, and improving interpretability.
Clearer action/model disclosure before Copilot submission suggests stronger emphasis on visibility and control in AI-assisted review workflows.

top_items: Enterprise Live Migrations from Azure DevOps generally available
Improvements on the pull request overview in public preview
themes_zh: 企业源码平台迁移正在从离线切换转向持续同步与短停机 cutover。
代码审查界面开始为 AI 参与式工作流做可见性和上下文管理优化。
themes_en: Enterprise source platform migrations are moving from offline switchover to continuous sync with short cutover windows.
Code review surfaces are being optimized for AI-participating workflows via better visibility and context management.
implications_zh: 若组织正在从 Azure DevOps 向 GitHub 迁移，应重新评估是否可以把迁移拆成持续同步 + 分批切换，而不是集中停机窗口。
若团队在推广 AI code review，应关注触发透明度、审查状态表达和噪音折叠机制，而不仅是模型能力本身。
implications_en: If your org is moving from Azure DevOps to GitHub, reassess whether migration can be decomposed into continuous sync plus staged cutovers instead of a centralized downtime event.
If your team is rolling out AI code review, pay attention to invocation transparency, review state communication, and noise-collapsing mechanics, not just model quality.

what_to_ignore_zh: 聚合型 GitHub Changelog 首页与月度归档页，信息重复且缺乏单点技术深度。
一般性的 PR 页面微调若与团队流程无关，可视为低优先级体验更新。
what_to_ignore_en: Aggregate GitHub Changelog index/archive pages; they are duplicative and lack focused technical depth.
General PR page polish can be treated as low-priority UX churn unless it maps directly to your review process.
